title: PlasBench
description: PlasBench benchmarks plasmid-reconstruction tools against complete-reference truth. Every tool, whether a classifier, a binner or a re-assembler, is reduced to one predicted-plasmid FASTA projected back onto a complete long-read or hybrid reference, so base-level precision, recall and F1 sit beside plasmid-level recovery and structural measures, with the evidence tier of every reference recorded. Command line and local browser window; Docker or conda; Galaxy and CWL wrappers for the scoring steps.
